tei:div.tei:p: 449)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: phag mo'i gsang sgrub cha lag: : tshogs mchod cha lag rgyun khyer ni: hrīḥ snang ba yangs pa'i bhan+dha'i nang: snod bcud dpal yon tshogs su bshams: zag med ye shes chen por brlabs: mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid thams cad dag pa che: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: 'gul bskyod thams cad phyag rgya gar: rdo rje lus kyi grong khyer du: gdan gsum rnam dag lha'i dkyil 'khor: ye rdzogs chen por lhun gyis grub: gshegs bzhugs brjod pa bral ba'i lha: chos dbyings klong nas gnas 'dir gshegs: snang srid dag mnyam rol pa las: bza' bca' btung ba yang dag rdzas: thabs shes rdzas mchog bla na med: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: sred len dang bral tshogs rdzogs nas: ka dag chos sku'i sa thob shog: ces pa'ang gsang grogs pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi bzhed skong du snyoms las pa su kha'i ming gis bris pa dge'o// 450)
